title: Vinland Saga
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In early-eleventh-century England and Scandinavia, the young Thorfinn fights for the mercenary Askeladd to win a duel to avenge his father. After Askeladd dies, Thorfinn is enslaved on a farm, renounces violence, and later sails to found a peaceful settlement in Vinland.
life_message: It holds up a life without enemies, where a person turns from revenge and violence toward peace and care for others.

content.note: Graphic battles with blood, dismemberment and slavery; the author frames violence as leading to no positive outcome (Wikipedia; CSM; AniList Gore, War).
War atrocities, children in battle, deaths of loved ones (CSM; AniList Tragedy).
Brief censored nudity; sexual violence implied (CSM on the anime).
Some profanity and slurs between nations (CSM on the anime).
Wine and beer; a warrior eats a strength-boosting mushroom (CSM).
Enslavement, trauma and guilt over past killings (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Abuse).
